quy_dao.tam: tam hop (cx, cy) [px] tren anh, nhan goc (khong lam tron)
quy_dao.dinh_nghia: huong psi(t) = atan2 cua c(t+k) - c(t-k), k = nua_cua_so*fps frame, chi khi ca hai frame co mat va |dich chuyen| >= max(dich_chuyen_toi_thieu_px, dich_chuyen_toi_thieu_theo_h * h(t)); dpsi(t) = |wrap(psi(t+T) - psi(t))|, T = khoang_doi_huong*fps frame, ca hai huong hop le. Loai: do dai < do_dai_toi_thieu -> loai_ngan; ti le huong hop le / huong tinh duoc < nguong hoac khong co dpsi -> loai_cham; max dpsi > nghi_nhieu_tren -> nghi_nhieu (dao chieu: nhieu / dung / doi ID); < thang_duoi -> thang; < cong_nhe_duoi -> cong_nhe; < cua_duoi -> cua; con lai -> cua_gat.
quy_dao.chi_so_do_nhay: p90 dpsi tren track (giam anh huong mot diem ngoai lai)

lop.bdd: 5 lop, box gan nhan (khong crowd / distractor)

quy_dao.ghi_chu_bdd: camera gan tren xe dang chay (ego-motion): ket qua la DOI HUONG TREN ANH, khong phai xe cua that
quy_dao.ghi_chu_detrac: camera co dinh, phoi canh: goc tren anh khac goc tren mat duong

mau_truc_quan.kich_thuoc: dien tich px goc: nho < 32^2, vua < 96^2, lon >= 96^2 (quy uoc COCO)

dieu_kien.bdd_train: kho = occluded hoac truncated (Scalabel); thuong = con lai
dieu_kien.bdd_val: unknown (COCO-video khong co occluded/truncated) -> mot nhom
dieu_kien.detrac: kho = co region_overlap hoac truncation_ratio > 0 hoac sence_weather in {night, rainy}

mau_truc_quan.cach_chon: moi o (lop x kich thuoc x dieu kien): 1 box, lay mau hoc chua (reservoir) deu tren moi box cua o, duyet video theo ten, frame theo thu tu; numpy default_rng(seed) rieng tung tap con
mau_truc_quan.anh_toan_khung: 2 frame / tap con (reservoir tren frame co >= 1 box gan nhan), ve moi box
mau_truc_quan.gioi_han: mau nho, chi phat hien loai loi; KHONG ket luan toan tap sach

gan_trung.mau_frame: moi video 4 frame: vi tri floor(0.1n), floor(0.5n), floor(0.9n) + 1 chi so ngau nhien (default_rng(crc32(video) ^ 48)) trong danh sach anh da sap xep
gan_trung.hash: dHash 256 bit: anh xam resize 17x16 (BILINEAR), so sanh cot lien ke
gan_trung.pham_vi: chi so cap thuoc HAI VIDEO KHAC NHAU, trong cung mien (BDD voi BDD, DETRAC voi DETRAC)
gan_trung.ghi_chu: ung vien phai xac nhan bang mat; frame lien nhau trong mot video khong tinh la boi canh doc lap

canh_xe_lon.dieu_kien: dien tich box lon >= 2 x box nho VA giao / dien tich box nho (IoA) >= 0.10, cung frame
canh_xe_lon.su_kien: chuoi frame lien tiep (khoang cach <= 1 frame nhan) cua cung cap (track nho, track lon)
canh_xe_lon.detrac_theo_nhan: region_overlap co occlusion_id tro toi target lop lon trong cung frame (dem rieng)
canh_xe_lon.ghi_chu: others cua UA-DETRAC la lop hon hop, thanh phan khong xac minh

mau_yolo.tang: split (train/dev) x xu_ly (sao_chep/to_xam) x co lop hiem (motorcycle|bicycle)
